title: Sill
tagline: Know what each gig is really worth.
description: Sill is a real-time earnings dashboard for working musicians. It syncs your gig calendar, tracks commute times and payouts, and computes your true hourly rate after travel and expenses. With a Mapbox-powered commute visualizer, Sill shows you which gigs are worth taking and which aren't.
niche: Working musicians, DJs, and performers who juggle multiple gigs and need to optimize their time and earnings.
visualDirection: Dark, data-dense workbench with a wallet-grade focus on numbers. Clean grid layout, monospace numerals for stats, and a hero with a huge circular gauge icon that animates to show true hourly rate.
features: Import gigs from calendar and see payouts, commute time, and expenses in one view
Automatic true hourly rate calculation: (payout - expenses) / (gig time + commute)
Mapbox-powered commute visualizer to overlay travel time on a map
Performance trend chart comparing gig earnings over weeks and months
Local-first storage: your data stays in your browser, no server required
Quick-add gig modal for manual entry when calendar sync isn't available
scopeNotes: No authentication, no backend database, no payment integration. Calendar import is simulated with sample data or manual entry. Mapbox is used for showing a static map with commute overlay, not for live navigation.
